title: feat(2d): V-Carve operation - depth from the region width along the medial axis
body:
## What changed

- A new 2D operation, **V-Carve** (kind tag 44). A V-bit carves a closed region. The tip follows the medial axis. At each point the depth is where the cone touches the two walls. A maximum depth (`Top Z - Bottom Z`) limits the cut.
- Motion kernel: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/vcarve.rs`, `vcarve_axis.rs`, `vcarve_walk.rs`.
  - The tip positions come from the largest inscribed circle at each sampled boundary point. The centre of that circle is a point of the medial axis.
  - The cone keeps a wall allowance of 0.01 mm. The kernel checks each straight feed move against the outline before it writes the move. A move that fails becomes a retract and a new plunge.
  - A branch into a corner that turns less than 20 degrees is not ridden. A tessellated circle is one dip, not a star.
  - Deep carves step down. An optional flat-clearing pass uses offset rings of the same V-bit inside the wall pass.
  - The cone height also limits the depth. The path carries a note when it does.
- App: the `VCarve` kind row, the generator arm, the seed, heights, the mark depth law (`DepthLaw::Mark`), the project-file arm `VCarve` (appended, no version step), posting and the setup sheet.
- Sim: a new `Mode::Carve`. It has the stand-downs of `Mode::Engrave`, and the crossing law is off. The walk rides each axis branch from its two walls, so the two rides lie on one another by design.
- UI: a V-Carve parameter page and an original icon (`assets/ui/op-v-carve.png`, `.svg`).
- MCP: the generic `add_operation` tool takes the kind `V-Carve`. `list_operation_types` lists the kind and its fields. No new MCP tool is necessary.
- The V-bit is the existing `Taper` tool kind. The included angle is the tool's `tip_angle`.

## Sources (literature)

The algorithm is written from these published sources. The module heads name them.

- H. Blum, "A transformation for extracting new descriptors of shape", 1967 (the medial axis transform).
- H. I. Choi, S. W. Choi, H. P. Moon, "Mathematical theory of medial axis transform", Pacific J. Math., 1997.
- J. Ma, S. W. Bae, S. Choi, "3D medial axis point approximation using nearest neighbors and the normal field", The Visual Computer, 2012 (the tangent-circle shrink).
- M. Foskey, M. C. Lin, D. Manocha, "Efficient computation of a simplified medial axis", 2003 (the separation angle).
- M. Held, "On the Computational Geometry of Pocket Machining", 1991 (the floor rings).
- The cone law `depth = radius / tan(angle / 2)` is machine-tool handbook geometry.

The session had no web access, so no Perplexity search ran. camlib was a feature list only. No code or output of another program was read.

## Cause

There was no V-carve operation. The engrave ride follows a line at one depth only.

## Tests

- `crates/motion/tests/v_carve.rs` (11 tests):
  - `the_cone_never_leaves_the_region`: sweeps the cone along the path against the region outline.
  - `the_depth_follows_the_width_of_the_region`, `a_sharp_corner_rises_to_the_surface`, `a_stroke_is_cut_in_one_engagement`, `a_tessellated_circle_is_one_dip_not_a_star`, `the_maximum_depth_limits_the_cut`, `flat_clearing_removes_the_floor_the_cone_cannot_reach`, `a_deep_carve_steps_down`, `a_cone_shorter_than_the_maximum_depth_limits_the_cut_and_says_so`.
  - `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`: angle, diameter, maximum depth, stepdown, feed, clearance, retract, stepover, non-finite numbers, an empty region.
  - `degenerate_regions_give_a_clean_answer`: a fuzz set of 45 regions (zero width, a 1 micron sliver, a bow tie, a spike, far from the origin, 40 seeded random polygons), with and without flat clearing. Each gives a clean error or a path whose cone stays inside.
- `crates/app/tests/v_carve_op.rs` (7 tests):
  - `a_letter_is_carved_verified_simulated_and_posted`: the letter L generates, the program sim finds 0 gouge cells, and it posts.
  - `the_letter_matches_its_golden_cl_file`: golden `crates/app/tests/golden/v_carve_letter_l.cl`.
  - `the_operation_is_undone_and_done_again`, `a_tool_that_is_not_a_v_bit_is_refused_by_name`, `a_top_typed_under_the_surface_is_a_gouge_that_holds_the_post`, `a_saved_v_carve_opens_with_its_numbers`, `over_mcp_a_letter_is_carved_verified_and_undone`.
- Red before the change: yes. The pins do not compile on `main`, because the kind and `v_carve` do not exist there.

### Mutation checks

- `link_ok` in `vcarve_walk.rs` always returns true: `the_cone_never_leaves_the_region` is red. Restored: green.
- `VCarve` removed from the mark law (`mark_law.rs`): `a_letter_is_carved_verified_simulated_and_posted` and `over_mcp_a_letter_is_carved_verified_and_undone` are red. Restored: green.
- `Mode::Carve` with the crossing law on: the letter L is refused (checked in the earlier session, see the decision record).
- `OpType::VCarve` declared after `Engrave` (its old place): `operation::tests::stamp_follows_every_input` (the registry row law) and 13 more app and ui steps are red. At the end of the enum: green. The held work had this defect; this PR fixes it.

### Kind-table pins that take the new kind

- `operation::tests::stamp_follows_every_input`: the registry count is 45.
- `lathe_voice::tests::every_kind_is_work_spindle_live_tool_or_refused_by_name`: the lathe refuses 32 kinds (was 31).
- `operation::types::tilt_basis::tests::the_tilt_slot_covers_each_kind_whose_file_shape_has_a_tilt`: `tilt_slot` now covers `VCarve` (code change in `tilt_basis.rs`; main's #2599 added the slot after the held work).
- `coarse_laws::every_kind_is_either_judged_or_refused_for_a_stated_reason_on_a_reduced_model`: `VCarve` is refused on a reduced model, as `Engrave` is.
- `ribbon::the_probe_appends_its_id_and_lists_in_drilling`: `SinkerSideBurn` keeps 43, `VCarve` is the tail at 44.

## Goldens moved

- One new golden: `crates/app/tests/golden/v_carve_letter_l.cl`.
- After the merge of `main`, its `START` line changed from `0 0 25000` to `6000 -3000 25000`. The cause is main's #2901: the opening rapid now starts over its own entry point. No move line changed.
- No existing golden changed.

## Gate

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on head `5343a166a`: green, 782 steps, 0 failed (59 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The branch contains `upstream/main` at `8be100737`. A trial merge (`git merge-tree`) with `aa4c785db` is clean. Those 68 commits do not touch the kind table, the `OpType` enum or the project-file arms.

## Not exercised

- A heavy-lane run (`cargo xtask gate heavy`). The diff reaches the `motion` and `app` heavy lanes; they did not run in this session.
- A second, flat tool for floor clearing. One operation holds one tool. A 2D Pocket with a flat tool does this today.
- A refusal for "a tip flat larger than the narrowest feature". The `Tool` record has no tip-flat field for a taper tool. This needs a tool-model change first.
- An exact segment Voronoi diagram. The decision record gives the reason and the cost to change later.
- The UI page was not driven by hand.

## Overlaps

- #3058 (Waterjet Profile) also appends kind tag 44 and `ALL[44]` in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`. These are appends to one table, not shared logic. The PR that merges second takes tag 45. The decision record has the reason for no stack.
- These open PRs touch the same files (`kinds.rs`, `generate.rs`, `types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `sim/src/verify/types.rs`) in other functions: #3115, #3108, #3103, #3099, #3097, #3087, #3080, #3059. Whichever merges second refreshes.

Decision record: `docs/decisions/1443-v-carve.md`.

Effort: max

Changelog: New 2D operation V-Carve: a V-bit carves a closed region along its medial axis, with the depth from the region width, a maximum depth, step-downs and optional flat clearing.

Fixes #1443
